headline: Ten sessions report. Nothing is broken; nine wait on you. Two quick 'commit and push' words and the Webglobe confirmation unblock the infra work; Q1-Q8 plus your signature unblock the whole MVP build.

needs_nigel.title: Answer Q1-Q8, then sign the scope baseline (#523)
needs_nigel.why: Scope freeze: no MVP feature code starts until you sign. 7 sessions' work merges with it.
needs_nigel.example: Q1: does the switch to -5 merge as soon as it's built (maps internal until Arigamaru's register entry), or wait for the entry?
needs_nigel.recommendation: Say 'ask me the questions': I'll run them with an example and a recommendation each, then you sign in planning 2.

needs_nigel.title: Confirm the Webglobe nameserver change
needs_nigel.why: The domain move to dev.ai-analytics.ai can't start until .ai shows the AWS nameservers.
needs_nigel.example: dig +short NS ai-analytics.ai @a.nic.ai shows four awsdns names.
needs_nigel.recommendation: Your coworker confirms the e-mail; then run the dig and tell me.

needs_nigel.title: 'commit and push the IdP fix' (infra session)
needs_nigel.why: Makes Terraform match what Cognito really does and keeps the domain cutover plan clean.
needs_nigel.example: Type exactly: commit and push the IdP fix
needs_nigel.recommendation: Do it before the domain cutover.

needs_nigel.title: 'commit and push' the Docker layer fix
needs_nigel.why: Stops ~1 GB of host disk per deploy and cuts rebuilds from 4.5 min to under a minute.
needs_nigel.recommendation: Yes: equivalence is proven (68 packages, 10,157 files identical).
needs_nigel.where: AIA fix: Docker dependency layer session

needs_nigel.title: Review the methodology packet (#510)
needs_nigel.why: Arigamaru's 24 MQ answers gate the numerical MVP chunks; nothing goes to him before you review.
needs_nigel.example: The PDF I sent earlier (methodology + engineering companion).
needs_nigel.recommendation: Read it, then say 'send to Arigamaru'.

needs_nigel.title: Decide ADRs 0028-0038 (#512)
needs_nigel.why: The architecture of the wallet, working copy, Lead and production depends on them; most are already settled by your 48 answers.
needs_nigel.example: ADR 0028: the wallet and plan card. Accept as drafted?
needs_nigel.recommendation: Accept them with the baseline signature; I'll list only the 'Open for Nigel' items left.
